fields.title: The Fed raises rates at its December 9 meeting
fields.text: The Federal Open Market Committee raises the target range for the federal funds rate above 3.75%-4.00% at the meeting that ends December 9, 2026. Yes covers a quarter-point rise to 4.00%-4.25% and a half-point rise to 4.25%-4.50%; No is a hold (or a cut).
